caption: The drawing features two rectangular swatches of woven fabric placed on a plain, light beige background. The larger swatch is positioned toward the top center and is composed of a repeating pattern with vertical bands on each side that alternate between green and dark blue geometric shapes on a cream color, and a central section with red and cream checkerboard and striped patterns. The inner bands have intricate symmetrical motifs, while the central section's pattern is lighter, with alternating rows and dots. The edges of the swatch display a border of red squares and dashes. Below and to the right of the large swatch, a smaller rectangular piece repeats part of the larger swatch's design, displaying primarily the red and blue checked areas. In the lower left below the large swatch, the name "Chas. Readman." is handwritten in small, neat print. The drawing's background is otherwise plain, focusing attention on the detailed patterns and colorwork of the woven textile samples.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
